mission.purpose: Support community wellbeing through voluntary participation, service referrals, and aggregate, non-identifying civic data.
objectives: Support community members in accessing services
Identify service availability and infrastructure gaps
Route civic issues to appropriate service organizations
Produce aggregate wellbeing metrics for civic improvement
Align municipal, county, state, and DAO governance

scope.data_purpose: Civic improvement and voluntary service referral only

data_handling: Aggregate signals before analysis, routing, or ledger anchoring
Suppress aggregate results with fewer than 10 contributions
Use coarse geographic categories only; do not record precise locations
Do not retain raw submissions or link submissions across interactions

steps.action: Route aggregate service or infrastructure issues to the relevant municipal service.
Route issues outside municipal scope to the relevant county service.
Escalate cross-county or state-program issues to the relevant state service.
Review governance compliance and aggregate outcomes; do not direct action toward individuals.

decision_constraints: Route by issue category and service jurisdiction only
Do not infer identity, intent, or individual risk
Offer referrals without requiring participation or disclosure
Log routing outcomes using aggregate data only

community_intake.function: Accept voluntary, anonymous community wellbeing signals.

civic_signal_processor.function: Validate, anonymize, and aggregate submitted signals.

routing_engine.function: Route aggregate civic issues to the appropriate municipal, county, state, or DAO destination.

resource_referral_engine.function: Provide optional information about shelters, food programs, medical clinics, social services, and community organizations.

governance_ledger_anchor.function: Anchor aggregate metrics, routing decisions, audit records, and compliance checks.

permitted_contents: Audit outcomes and DAO compliance checks
